in_marathi.name: Sharali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharali is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means 'Shining One'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharah', which means 'head' or 'chief', and 'ali', which means 'shining' or 'radiant'. Sharali is a beautiful name for a girl that signifies leadership, brightness, and excellence.
